desc:
👍 THUMBS UP FOR MORE UPDATES! 👍
Welcome to Build a Store! 🏪

Start with an empty plot and build your very own store brick by brick! 🧱 Collect materials, place every piece, and watch your empty plot turn into a massive store!

🎮 How to Play

🧱 Collect & Build – Gather materials and place thousands of pieces to construct your store!

📈 Upgrade – Earn cash while building to unlock better tools, faster movement, bigger storage, and powerful upgrades!

🏪 Expand – Keep building to unlock new sections, bigger stores, and more exciting areas!

👥 Play Together – Build alongside your friends and work together to finish your store faster!

🏆 Compete – Build your store as quickly as possible and climb the global leaderboards!

💻 PC Controls
U - Upgrades
Q - Shop
T - Settings
Click – Place

🔨 Can you build the biggest and best store?

#Satisfying #ASMR #Building
